sloka: ।किं वैष्णवं वा कपिरूपमेत्य रक्षोविनाशाय परं सुतेजः ।अनन्तमव्यक्तमचिन्त्यमेकं स्वमायया साम्प्रतमागतं वा ।। 5.54.38 ।।।।
transliteration: ।kiṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ vā kapirūpametya rakṣovināśāya paraṁ sutejaḥ ।anantamavyaktamacintyamekaṁ svamāyayā sāmpratamāgataṁ vā ।। 5.54.38 ।।।।

translations.english: All eminent demons having collected together, quickly surveyed the situation.Seeing the burnt city, with all its living creatures, houses and trees consigned to the flames, they spoke to one another.
translations.hindi: उस भयंकर राक्षसी ने भ्रट्टहास कर तथा गरज कर और निर्भीक हो यह्‌ झनुचित वचन मुझसे कहा
